title: Two rounds depend only on the first two blocks
statement: For all natural numbers $N$ and $\ell$ and every binary string $r$, the result of two Euler-liar rounds using blocks of length $\ell$ is unchanged when the random string is truncated to its first $2\ell$ bits.
